steps.note: 06:00 after Wipe both: Netherton suspends the player and the closing moves to the hearing, which sets closing_done and ends the night.

said: Nobody holds the whole map now.
As of now you are suspended, pending a hearing.
That is why you are suspended and I am not.
notSaid: His copy goes into the vault tonight
A trial. He will make speeches.

said: A hearing room at the Citadel, two days later.
The map's gone. He's one man with a memory now.
Tell them. Short, and true. They can count.
They'll ask me if I'd have stopped you. I'll tell them I wasn't asked.
DIRECTOR MAGNUS NETHERTON: Director. Still in his chair.
AGENT HAX: Handler. Gave her evidence at the hearing in one sentence.
